# std.stream

The program's one random stream, the same on every engine and build. Core re-exports `rand`, so no module imports it; `std.rand` builds `shuffle`, `gen` and `Rng` on top.

Import: `use std.stream.{...}`.

## Functions

- `fn rand(lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int` — `rand(lo, hi)`: an `Int` in `lo..=hi` drawn from the program's one random stream, the same on every engine and build (R02.10.1).
